shows: PLUM (mustard suit) and BOTTLE (brown tweed) shake a canvas sack so banknotes pour out and flutter down to the clouds, then hold the empty sack out flat, deadpan, to the lens.
faults: triangles small and near centre of face, hard to read which side; otherwise none seen

shows: CRIMSON drives (fedora, pinstripe), MARINE in cream braces both hands on the dashboard; they swerve past an upset orange cart as a policeman stumbles clear.
faults: crimson's red triangle invisible on red mask; swerve is mild, mostly a straight drive; background buildings shift slightly

place: rope ladder under a flying plane, farmland below
shows: MARINE in cream linen hangs off a rope ladder below a plane's wing and lifts the cash bag towards the lens for a cocky shake, then lets it hang.

place: dark room behind a wooden door
shows: CRIMSON with a tommy gun presses to the wall beside a door as a bullet punches through, splinters fly and shafts of daylight cut the dust.
faults: red triangle invisible on red mask; man barely flinches

shows: PLUM (mustard) and BOTTLE (tweed) stand either side of a stolen safe on a sack truck in front of an open vault door; PLUM gestures at the safe and himself, BOTTLE rocks the truck.
faults: PLUM's head turns side-on around 2 s; no knuckle-rap on the safe, gestures are small; triangle side unclear at strip size

place: cobbled street under elevated railway, night
shows: A red 1930s sedan spins its wheels and drifts away under the El tracks as sparks shower from above; the camera then swings into a dark riveted pillar.
faults: no gang in shot; last ~1.5 s is a black riveted pillar filling the frame (unusable tail)

place: frozen lake by a neon city, night
shows: A teal sedan skids across ice spraying snow, chased by a police motorbike with sidecar that rides up to the lens.
faults: no gang; car driver unmasked; readable fake neon words on the skyline

place: high girder view over a night drag strip
shows: From a rusty tower, cars race down a lit strip lined with parked cars and onlookers, city glow behind; ends in a blurred whip pan.
faults: no gang; cars tiny; last ~1.3 s is whip-pan blur

shows: A green hot rod with an unmasked driver in a flat cap rolls slowly at the low camera, headlight flaring until it whites out the frame.
faults: no gang; driver unmasked; readable fake shop sign words; ends in headlight white-out

place: concrete river channel under bridges, sunset
shows: A mustard hot rod drives along the sloped bank while a teal one ploughs up the water towards the lens, crowd watching from the parapet; it swerves past close.
faults: no gang; drivers unmasked; teal car's close pass at ~5 s is a blurry body panel

shows: A green safe is dragged on a chain behind a yellow car, throwing sparks, then breaks loose and tumbles to a stop, ending pushed up into the lens.
faults: no gang; safe shifts position oddly between beats (car moves away and back); faint readable fake shop signs

place: back seat of a car, rear window
shows: A masked man in a dark coat turns from the rear window to look back at the lens, hands on the glass, until headlights flare the frame white.
faults: wrong mask: pale grey with a BLACK ring and a big centred triangle, not any gang member; dark coat matches no suit; ends in a white flare
